title: Colonization of Government Lands Punjab Amendment Ordinance 1999

sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Government Lands Punjab Amendment Ordinance 1999
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 1999
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT
LANDS (PUNJAB) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE
XLVIII OF 1999
An Ordinance
further to amend the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, ' 27th September, 1999]
No. Legis.
3(XLVIII)/99, dated 27-9-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1.
Short title and commencement.--(1.) This Ordinance may be called the
Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the
day the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
(XXVIII of- 1999) stands repealed under Article 128(2) of the Constitution.

3(XLVIII)/99, dated 27-9-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the

2.
Amendment of section 24 of .Act V of 1912.--In the Colonization of
Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 (V of 1912) hereinafter referred to as the
said Act in section 24, in subsection (a) for the words "five thousand
rupees" the words "ten thousand rupees" shall be substituted.
